messages:
Maya (infra): FYI onboarding new tenant org `acme-analytics` into GCP eu-west4. Need to provision A100 capacity + extra internal IPs for node pools. Raised a support case. Case: 0241234567. Anyone able to help coordinate with GCP? :wave:
Priya (eng-infra): do we have the GCP project ID and billing account set up yet? need those for the quota request form
Maya (infra): proj id is `redwood-acme-euw4`, billing is attached to our central billing `redwood-prod-billing`. I submitted the quota request in console and got the case number above.
Leo (cloudops): yup saw the form. GCP is asking for justification and expected sustained usage. Can someone paste expected concurrency / GPUs and retention?
Maya (infra): initial demand: 8 A100s for training-prep, but steady state 4 A100s serving. NICs: need /26 per nodepool, plan 2 nodepools so requesting +256 internal IP addresses.
Ash (sre): also flagging that eu-west4 currently has regional shortage for A100s per status page. We should ask for burst region fallback to `europe-west1` in the same request if they can't commit capacity.
Maya (infra): good point — added that to the case comment: "prefer eu-west4, fallback europe-west1".
sre-bot: Deploybot detected config update: added `nodepool-acme` to cluster manifest — no deploy until quota approved.
GCP Support: Hello Maya — Case 0241234567 assigned. We need the project numeric ID and an estimated monthly vCPU & GPU consumption. Also sharing a link to expedited review if required: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/0241234567
Maya (infra): numeric id is 123456789012. Estimated monthly: ~288k vCPU-seconds, ~3.2M GPU-minutes (rough). Also added cost/justification doc in the case: link to internal doc `docs/onboarding/acme-cost-justif.md`.
Priya (eng-infra): tagging @TAM for faster turnaround — we have a production SLA kickoff next week.
TAM - Google: Hi team — I see the case. I escalated to the quota team for eu-west4 A100s and requested cross-region capacity fallback. ETA for initial reply ~4 hours, accelerated by your TAM note.
Leo (cloudops): can GCP also raise ENI / vNIC per instance limits? we might need more network interfaces for sidecars.
GCP Support: We'll include quota increases for GPUs, GCE regional cores, and internal IPs. For ENI/vNIC, confirm the VM family and instance type you'll use.
Maya (infra): using n1-standard for control VMs and `a2-highgpu-1g` family for A100 single-gpu instances, but we may use multi-gpu variants later. Add ENI for `a2` family.
Ash (sre): pls make sure the request asks for ephemeral quota first, not permanent commit. We can request temporary burst + monitoring.
Maya (infra): updated case comment: requesting temporary burst of 12 A100s for 2 weeks, then permanent quota of 6. Also requested +512 internal IPs and increased regional core quota + ENI allowances.
GCP Support: Update: quota team approved temporary burst in eu-west4 to 12 A100s (effective immediately). Permanent quota request still under review — case 0241234567 -> escalation ID 0241234567-ESCL.
Priya (eng-infra): awesome. Who should own rollback if we hit capacity/overage? Ash?
Ash (sre): I'll own rollback plan. Plan: if billing/usage spikes unexpectedly, reduce nodepool sizes and switch traffic to europe-west1. I'll add autoscaling cap to the helm values as an immediate control (`maxReplicas: 6`).
Maya (infra): Thanks all. Action items: (1) Ash add autoscale caps (2) Leo confirm instance family ENI limits with cloudops ticket (3) Priya follow up on permanent quota ETA tomorrow.
Leo (cloudops): filed internal ticket #INFRA-4827 to track ENI numbers and cost. Linking it in the case.
TAM - Google: Permanent quota teams asked for longer-term usage graph; if you can attach 7-day window of request rate and peak token throughput that'll speed approval.
Maya (infra): I'll export our prom dashboard and attach. Expect a follow-up in ~12 hours. :thumbsup:
GCP Support: Closing note: temporary burst active. Permanent quota still pending. We'll update case 0241234567 and notify here when changed.
Maya (infra): marking this thread as the coordination point. I'll post case updates here. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
